g.title: OX54
g.text: OX-54 — Reproducible pack builds and distinct variant
Behavior / contract proposal for owner review

g.title: cluster_variant
g.text: Prove a distinct supported content variant

g.title: baseline
g.text: record exact source bytes and versions

g.title: meanings
g.text: OX-20 packId = stable logical pack identity
OX-51 asset SHA-256 = exact referenced-file integrity
OX-54 payload digest = canonical content identity
ZIP-byte SHA-256, if recorded = exact archive/transport-byte integrity

g.title: olive
g.text: its own manifest v2 + exact PNG bytes
same world and required renderer capability

g.title: rule
g.text: SHA-256 over a domain/version prefix, entry count, and every canonical relative path + exact payload bytes;
entries sorted by UTF-8 path bytes and length-framed. Include manifest and declared resources.
Exclude ZIP headers, member order, timestamps, compression, modes, and other container metadata.

g.title: consumer
g.text: Builder reports the OX-54 payload digest.
Future validator and installer consume this exact rule; their runtime implementation stays in later slices.

g.title: out_of_scope
g.text: No manifest-v2 field changes, runtime decode/validation/install, origin or entitlement policy, app UI, scene activation, system matrix, or device tests.
